definitions.explanation: A person, especially a young woman, who dances professionally or as a performer. Often evokes a traditional or literary image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The dancer on stage was beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踊|おど}り{子|こ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踊|おど}った→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
examples.english: The dancers performed brilliantly at the festival.

examples.japanese: {川端康成|かわばたやすなり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧『{伊豆|いず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り{子|こ}』⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本文学|にほんぶんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Kawabata Yasunari's 'The Izu Dancer' is widely known as a masterpiece of Japanese literature.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧ (dancing) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (person, child). The word carries a traditional, somewhat romantic connotation compared to the modern loanword ⟦ダンサー→ダンサー：08801_dansaa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り{子|こ} (festival dancer)
- {踊|おど}り{子|こ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (dancers perform)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{川端康成|かわばたやすなり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}→短編小説：20776_tanpenshousetsu⟧『{伊豆|いず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{踊|おど}り{子|こ}』(The Izu Dancer, 1926) is one of the most famous works in Japanese literature, telling the story of a student's encounter with a troupe of traveling performers. The word {踊|おど}り{子|こ} is strongly associated with this work.
